description: Nine pass or fail accounting signals (profitability, leverage and liquidity, efficiency) added into a 0 to 9 score. Signals that compare two years are scored only when both years are given.

assetTurnoverValue.description: Optional: revenue / total assets, current year (F9)

grossMarginValue.description: Optional: gross margin as a decimal, current year (F8)

operatingCashFlow.description: Cash flow from operations, current year

priorAssetTurnoverValue.description: Optional: revenue / total assets, prior year (F9)

priorGrossMarginValue.description: Optional: gross margin as a decimal, prior year (F8)

priorTotalAssets.description: Optional: total assets, prior year (F3, F5)

name: piotroski_f_score
title: Piotroski F-Score
